title: 第3546章 是有人故意为之第3545章 先帮你检查一下身体
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
content_zh:
听到这话，柳青瑶娇躯一颤，脸颊肉眼可见的变得羞红起来。
“躺到床上？”
她脸上浮现犹豫之色：
“这......”
作为柳家的千金，柳青瑶别说跟当着别的男人面躺到床上了，就算是跟陌生男子共处一室都从来没有过。
而且......检查身体，势必需要身体接触。
柳青瑶一时间心中有些摇摆不定：
“他是真的想帮我检查身体，还是想要趁着这次机会占我便宜？”
“可要是不按照他说的做......我可能会失去身体痊愈的机会。”
“可要是真的那么做了，他对我做点什么......”
不自觉之间，柳青瑶攥紧了粉拳，表情变幻不定。
“柳姑娘......”
李长生看向柳青瑶，叫了一声：
“你怎么了？”
柳青瑶回过神来，勉强露出一抹笑意：
“检查完身体之后，前辈真的可以帮晚辈治疗好体内的丹毒吗？”
李长生扯了扯嘴角：
“这种事情谁能说得清楚？”
“一切都需要查看过你现在丹毒侵入身体的状况来判断。”
“不过姑娘放心，即便你体内丹毒已经侵入神魂，本座最少也能够帮你将体内的一部分丹毒逼出来。”

“那样，以后你或许就不必再承受那么多的痛苦了。”
柳青瑶深吸口气，面色逐渐变得坚定：
“前辈，我相信你.......”
她起身，走到了床铺，缓缓躺了下去：
“前辈，开始吧......”
李长生站在床边，却并未动手，嘴角浮现一抹微不可察的笑意，一闪而逝。
随后正色道：
“姑娘，还请将外衣脱掉。”
“检查身体需要肌肤接触，隔着衣物做出的判断可能出现差错......”
柳青瑶原本坚定的表情，顿时一怔：
“还要脱衣服？”
“能不脱吗？”
李长生摇头：
“不脱的话，可能无法做出精准的判断。”
“柳姑娘，我知道你害羞。”
“但是你现在要想明白一个问题，现在你只是一个病人，我是医生。”
“你可不能因为讳疾忌医。”
content_en:
Hearing this, Liu Qingyao's delicate body trembled, and her cheeks became visibly red with embarrassment.
"Lie on the bed?"
A look of hesitation appeared on her face:
"This..."
As the daughter of the Liu family, Liu Qingyao has never even lied on the bed in front of other men, or even been in the same room with a strange man.
And... physical examination is bound to require physical contact.
Liu Qingyao was wavering in her heart for a moment:
"Does he really want to check me out, or is he trying to take advantage of me?"
"But if I don't do what he says...I might lose the chance of my body healing."
"But if he really did that, he would do something to me..."
Unconsciously, Liu Qingyao clenched her pink fist tightly, her expression changing.
"Miss Liu..."
Li Changsheng looked at Liu Qingyao and shouted:
"What's wrong with you?"
Liu Qingyao came back to her senses and forced a smile:
"After checking the body, can the senior really help the junior to cure the erysipelas in the body?"
Li Changsheng twitched his lips:
"Who can explain this kind of thing clearly?"
"Everything needs to be judged by looking at the current situation of erysipelas invading your body."
"But don't worry, girl, even if the erysipelas in your body has invaded your soul, I can at least help you force some of the erysipelas out of your body."
"That way, you might not have to endure so much pain in the future."
Liu Qingyao took a deep breath and her expression gradually became firm:
"Senior, I believe you..."
She got up, walked to the bed, and slowly lay down:
"Senior, let's start..."
Li Changsheng stood beside the bed, but did not make a move. An imperceptible smile appeared on the corner of his mouth and disappeared in a flash.
Then he said seriously:
"Girl, please take off your coat."
"Body examination requires skin-to-skin contact, and judgments made through clothing may be wrong..."
Liu Qingyao's originally firm expression suddenly became startled:
"You still want to take off your clothes?"
"Can you not take it off?"
Li Changsheng shook his head:
"If you don't take it off, you may not be able to make accurate judgments."
"Miss Liu, I know you are shy."
"But you have to think about something now. You are just a patient now, and I am a doctor."
"You can't avoid medical treatment just because you hide your illness."
